title: Docs: add GCP Marketplace onboarding + AWS vs GCP comparison
author: Kira Thompson
release_notes: Docs only: publish GCP Marketplace onboarding guide and a short AWS vs GCP flow comparison to reduce buyer confusion and support load.
description:
Adds a new docs page covering end-to-end onboarding for customers purchasing Redwood Inference via Google Cloud Marketplace, plus a comparison section that clarifies how the AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace flows differ (purchase, entitlement activation, org linking, regions, and common failure modes). The goal is to reduce back-and-forth during procurement and cut support tickets caused by mismatched expectations between AWS/GCP flows.

What’s included: (1) New page: “GCP Marketplace onboarding” with prerequisites, purchase steps, how to link a GCP purchase to an existing/new Redwood org, verification steps in Console, and a troubleshooting FAQ focused on GCP-specific errors (region mismatch, org already linked, delayed entitlement propagation). (2) Add “AWS vs GCP: what’s different?” section to the marketplace onboarding landing/overview so Sales/SE/CS can quickly point prospects to one canonical comparison. (3) Tightened wording on security/compliance statements to match the approved security FAQ language (no new claims; avoids implying customer data is used for training).

Notes/assumptions: This PR assumes the Console shows the Marketplace entitlement status panel and provides an “Org linking” flow for marketplace buyers. Where the UI copy may change, the docs call out the label text we expect today and link to the Console navigation path rather than hard-coding screenshots.

Checklist: - [x] Verified internal links + nav placement - [x] Ran spellcheck/lint - [x] Security wording reviewed (audit logs / encryption / retention phrasing) - [x] Added troubleshooting entries for top support cases - [x] Added comparison section for AWS vs GCP - [x] Added UTM-safe outbound links for Marketplace listings (placeholders until final listing URLs)

Follow-ups (out of scope): Add short 60s screen recording to the GCP page once UI is final; update pricing page CTAs after GCP listing URLs are published; revisit troubleshooting once partner validation feedback is final.

Refs: Linear ENG-4405 (GCP onboarding docs), PM-875 (launch readiness); aligns with Marketplace listing refresh copy owned by Soojin/Camila and security FAQ owned by Aisha/Marcus.
commits: docs(gcp): add GCP Marketplace onboarding page (prereqs, purchase steps, org linking, verify)
docs(marketplace): add AWS vs GCP comparison section + cross-links
docs(troubleshooting): add GCP-specific FAQ entries (region mismatch, entitlement delay, org already linked)
docs(copy): normalize security language to match marketplace security FAQ (no over-claims)
chore(nav): add GCP page to Marketplace docs group + sidebar ordering
review_conversation:
Elliot Price (review): The structure looks good. Two nits: (1) Can we move the ‘verification’ step earlier so readers confirm org linking before trying to call the API? (2) Please avoid hard-coding UI button labels if they’re likely to change; prefer ‘In Console → Settings → Marketplace’ style navigation.

Kira Thompson (author): Good call. Reordered the flow to: Purchase → Link org → Verify entitlement → Generate API key. Also replaced specific button labels with navigation paths and added a short note about UI text potentially changing.

Markus Klein (review): On the comparison section, can we explicitly answer the question prospects keep asking: ‘If I buy via GCP Marketplace, can I deploy in AWS?’ Even if the answer is ‘not directly’ we should be unambiguous.

Kira Thompson (author): Added a bullet under ‘Regions & billing account’ clarifying that marketplace purchases are tied to the marketplace provider and billing account; multi-cloud deployments are supported by Redwood but require matching entitlements/billing (and to contact Sales/Support for a coordinated setup).

Soojin Lee (review): Copy request: in the opening paragraph, can we lead with the procurement benefit (committed spend, consolidated billing) and keep the developer steps second? Also, please align the one-liner with listing headline language.

Kira Thompson (author): Updated intro to lead with procurement benefits, then ‘developer-first activation’ steps; aligned the first sentence with the current messaging framework.

Marcus Lin (review): Security wording: please remove ‘encrypted at rest in all systems’ — that’s too absolute. Suggest: ‘We encrypt customer data at rest and in transit using industry-standard mechanisms; details available in the security packet under NDA.’ Also avoid implying audit logs are always enabled for every plan; phrase as ‘available’ / ‘configurable.’

Kira Thompson (author): Updated phrasing per suggestion across GCP page + comparison section. Added ‘availability depends on SKU/add-ons’ note where relevant and linked to the Marketplace Security FAQ page.

Elliot Price (final): Approved after last push. Please ensure sidebar order matches AWS page and that the comparison section anchors are stable.

Kira Thompson (author): Done; added explicit anchors and confirmed sidebar ordering.
